title: Infrastructure Validation
preview: Infrastructure validation focused on proving that the main services were correctly deployed and reachable in the final environment. This includes the Kafka cluster, HDFS cluster, Hive Metastore, Spark cluster, Trino cluster, Kerberos services, browser-facing TLS gateways, and the monitoring stack . title: Observability and Monitoring Validation
preview: Observability validation confirms that the platform does not rely only on raw container logs for diagnosis. Instead, it exposes a structured monitoring layer composed of: Prometheus for metric collection; Grafana for dashboard-based visibility; cAdvisor on VM1, VM2, and VM3 for node/container metrics; pipeline-related exporters and Airflow run history for workflow evidence. This monitoring layer matters academically
preview2: because it strengthens the maturity of the platform. A distributed system is harder to defend when failures can only be explained retrospectively through manual shell inspection. Here, the project shows that service states, cluster readiness, and pipeline outcomes are visible through explicit observability mechanisms .
